notes: The pack-side 50 A conservative current cap is now supported by the manufacturer technical-reference example stating a 23 degC temperature rise at 50 A with 6 AWG; it is not applied to the former 10 AWG cable configuration.

The 5900 high-force contact is a 6 AWG contact. Anderson lists 5915 for 12-10 AWG and provides reducing bushing 5910 for using the 5900/1307 #6 barrel with 12-10 AWG, while warning that electrical capability is derated with smaller wire.
The IEC table separately identifies 50 A, 250 V, 16 mm^2 wire, and contact series 5900/1307; those tested-configuration facts remain preserved and are not flattened into universal contact limits.
